screenshots.notes: collaboration-dark-extended / 01-selected-reference: Selected document passage and fixed-version recipient reference card remain visible beside the original Composer text; document is in the right pane.
collaboration-dark-extended / 02-local-draft: Draft toolbar and saved local text are visible in the right pane, with original document tab and Composer reference retained.

collaboration-dark-extended / 03-permission-with-later-input: Permission request stays inside the editor footer with allow/deny/cancel controls; later text and Composer draft remain visible, without an overlay; disclosure icon and title share one aligned row.
collaboration-dark-extended / 04-applied-result: Applied result and real Provider diff are localized below the editor; later input remains above and is distinct from the fixed submitted revision.

collaboration-dark-extended / 05-three-way-comparison: Original baseline, local draft and explicitly read current file have distinct headings; original operation history remains visible without overwriting the draft.
collaboration-dark-extended / 05b-denied-preserved: Denied authorization is explained in the local footer; editor and original Composer remain available, with no success presentation.
collaboration-dark-extended / 05c-conflict-preserved: Version conflict has local compare-current control and preserves draft/Composer; no automatic replacement or whole-panel disabled state appears.
collaboration-dark-extended / 06-native-document: Independent document shows rendered Markdown heading, source path and reading/edit controls in a rounded bounded viewport.
collaboration-dark-extended / 07-native-close-preserved: Blocked native close retains the complete composing input and shows a local save/composition explanation; the window remains open.
collaboration-dark-extended / 08-native-directory: Independent directory view shows the bounded fixture tree, source identity and return/close controls within the rounded reading area.
collaboration-dark-extended / 08-native-comparison: Independent comparison shows real added/deleted lines, source range, file selector and independent window controls without modal chrome.

collaboration-dark-extended / 09-native-browser: Native browser chrome has address-copy identity and scoped return/close controls; guest pixels are excluded by this capture API and reviewed in the separate content image.

collaboration-dark-extended / 09b-native-browser-content: Separate unmodified WebContentsView pixels show the real loopback page heading and empty independent form; this is not a composited whole-window capture.
